project.name: Stratemark marketing site
project.notes: Static single-file landing page plus four legal pages. No build step; opens by double-click. Marketing only — the product app lives elsewhere.

motion.reducedMotion: honoured — marquee and all transitions disabled

patterns.name: mcard
patterns.what: company metric card: logo, name, category, score ring, one-liner, HQ, 3x2 metric grid with confidence labels, tier footer

patterns.name: deck rail
patterns.what: horizontal scroll-snap carousel; arrows disable at ends, edge fade, keyboard arrows/Home/End, contain:paint

patterns.name: plan
patterns.what: pricing card; featured variant uses brand ring not a colour fill

patterns.name: step
patterns.what: text-led numbered card with a ghost numeral via ::after

patterns.name: tier
patterns.what: toggle button strip driven by aria-pressed, feeding an aria-live detail panel

must: Zero !important — one stylesheet, tokens are the only source of truth
Every colour/space/size value comes from a token, never a raw literal in a component
Page must stay readable with JavaScript disabled; reveals are opt-in via the .js class
No horizontal overflow at any width — fix leaks at source, never mask with overflow-x:hidden
GitHub URL is real (github.com/squarepegng/stratemark); keep the yellow legal chips intact until Tobi fills them
Confidence vocabulary is fixed: verified / estimated / unknown
avoid: App/product screenshots — removed at the client's request 12 Aug 2026
Fake browser or macOS window chrome around imagery
Gradient text that terminates in a low-contrast grey
Vivid #16A36A as small text — use the darkened text variant, vivid only for dots and rings

decisions.decision: Rebuilt on one token-based stylesheet, replacing three stacked CSS generations and 89 !important rules.
Light-only palette matching the product UI. No dark mode yet.
Removed all app screenshots; Trust and How sections are text-led.

evidence.what: full audit, bug list and rationale for every change
